CommCenter is meant to be product agnostic, thus it needs one endpoint to call to get all user metadata.
On first iteration, this returns the same thing as EmployeeController.GetAccessRightsByUserId for the branch given. However, this can be extended to provide any extra information that CommCenter might need without having to alter CommCenter.
This is meant to be called with an Admin token to avoid any permissions issues reading the data.
WARNING: Be careful how much data this returns. It is called in a Browser -> CommCenter API -> PestPac API ... BEFORE the CIP loads in the browser. A huge payload really slows down this load process and affects the user. This is the reason it's narrowed down to specific branches.

Returns the latest TrackingLink info for a ServiceOrder. This is designed to be called by as a Webhook by TechTracker when serving the link to the end customer.
This functionality allows TechTracker to only pull the latest information from PestPac when using the link, instead of having PestPac push data to the TechTracker when data changes.
This is intended for internal (system-to-system) use only.
